encoding: Uint8 row-major 360x180, row 0 centred at 89.5N, column 0 centred at 179.5W. 0 = under 0.05 people per km2; 1..255 = log10 scale, density = 0.1 * 10^(5 * (code - 1) / 254) people per km2 of land, clamped to 0.1..10000.
